title.en: Revising the Rates of Specific Tax on Gasoline

text.en:
The rates of specific tax on gasoline under Section 153(c) of the National Internal Revenue Code of
1977, as amended, are hereby revised, to wit:
Regular gasoline
Premium gasoline

This Executive Order shall take effect on August 1, 1979.
Done in the City of Manila, this 1st day of August, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-nine.
